title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of 50 Solar-System bodies. The physical/orbital/derived spine is source-hardened for the major planets, and the first blinded geophysical evidence batch now codes composition, atmosphere and differentiation for 10 anchor bodies under a pre-frozen protocol while all rows remain unexposed to QCA results.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C022 froze the case frame, variable architecture and anti-circularity model ladder before analysis. Pilot-1 built the raw/orbit/derived spine and source-hardened the eight planet orbits. Evidence protocol v0.1 was frozen before coding. Anchor batch 01 then coded high-confidence NASA-supported composition, atmosphere and differentiation states for the eight planets plus Ceres and Pluto, with per-variable source keys and conservative unresolved cells left pending. No QCA calibration or solution inspection occurred.

tables.status: case frame + physical + orbit + derived + evidence v0.2
